import Mathlib

theorem p08 : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ p, N < p ∧ Nat.Prime p := by
  intro N
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hprime⟩ := Nat.exists_infinite_primes (N + 1)
  exact ⟨p, hp, hprime⟩
reasoning: Not compiled — reasoned only. `Nat.exists_infinite_primes` in Mathlib states ∀ n, ∃ p ≥ n, p.Prime; instantiating at N+1 gives N + 1 ≤ p, which is definitionally N < p, so `exact ⟨p, hp, hprime⟩` closes the goal.
